1	# Rooms for direct message chats between users. These act as a singleton, so a single set of users will
     2	# always refer to the same direct room.
     3	class Rooms::Direct < Room
     4	  class << self
     5	    def find_or_create_for(users)
     6	      find_for(users) || create_for({}, users: users)
     7	    end
     8	
     9	    private
    10	      # FIXME: Find a more performant algorithm that won't be a problem on accounts with 10K+ direct rooms,
    11	      # which could be to store the membership id list as a hash on the room, and use that for lookup.
    12	      def find_for(users)
    13	        all.joins(:users).detect do |room|
    14	          Set.new(room.user_ids) == Set.new(users.pluck(:id))
    15	        end
    16	      end
    17	  end
    18	
    19	  def default_involvement
    20	    "everything"
    21	  end
    22	end
====
     1	class Room < ApplicationRecord
     2	  has_many :memberships, dependent: :delete_all do
     3	    def grant_to(users)
     4	      room = proxy_association.owner
     5	      Membership.insert_all(Array(users).collect { |user| { room_id: room.id, user_id: user.id, involvement: room.default_involvement } })
     6	    end
     7	
     8	    def revoke_from(users)
     9	      destroy_by user: users
    10	    end
    11	
    12	    def revise(granted: [], revoked: [])
    13	      transaction do
    14	        grant_to(granted) if granted.present?
    15	        revoke_from(revoked) if revoked.present?
    16	      end
    17	    end
    18	  end
    19	
    20	  has_many :users, through: :memberships
    21	  has_many :messages, dependent: :destroy
    22	
    23	  belongs_to :creator, class_name: "User", default: -> { Current.user }
    24	
    25	  validate :direct_rooms_keep_their_type, on: :update
    26	
    27	  scope :opens,           -> { where(type: "Rooms::Open") }
    28	  scope :closeds,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Closed") }
    29	  scope :directs,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    30	  scope :without_directs, -> { where.not(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    31	
    32	  scope :ordered, -> { order("LOWER(name)") }
    33	
    34	  class << self
    35	    def create_for(attributes, users:)
    36	      transaction do
    37	        create!(attributes).tap do |room|
    38	          room.memberships.grant_to users
    39	        end
    40	      end
    41	    end
    42	
    43	    def original
    44	      order(:created_at).first
    45	    end
    46	  end
    47	
    48	  def receive(message)
    49	    unread_memberships(message)
    50	    push_later(message)
    51	  end
    52	
    53	  def open?
    54	    is_a?(Rooms::Open)
    55	  end
    56	
    57	  def closed?
    58	    is_a?(Rooms::Closed)
    59	  end
    60	
    61	  def direct?
    62	    is_a?(Rooms::Direct)
    63	  end
    64	
    65	  def default_involvement
    66	    "mentions"
    67	  end
    68	
    69	  private
    70	    # Open and closed rooms convert into each other freely. A direct room can't become
    71	    # either: its participants agreed to a private conversation, not to one whose
    72	    # audience someone else gets to widen afterwards.
    73	    def direct_rooms_keep_their_type
    74	      if type_changed? && type_was == "Rooms::Direct"
    75	        errors.add :type, "can't be changed for a direct room"
    76	      end
    77	    end
    78	
    79	    def unread_memberships(message)
    80	      memberships.visible.disconnected.where.not(user: message.creator).update_all(unread_at: message.created_at, updated_at: Time.current)
    81	    end
    82	
    83	    def push_later(message)
    84	      Room::PushMessageJob.perform_later(self, message)
    85	    end
    86	end

     4	  before_action :remember_last_room_visited, only: :show

     6	  def index

    11	    @messages = find_messages
    12	  end

    14	  def destroy

    17	    broadcast_remove_room

    19	  end
    20	
    21	  private
    22	    def set_room
    23	      if room = room_scope.find_by(id: params[:room_id] || params[:id])
    24	        @room = room
    25	      else
    26	        redirect_to root_url, alert: "Room not found or inaccessible"
    27	      end
    28	    end
    29	
    30	    # Subclasses narrow this to the room types they're allowed to act on, so that one
    31	    # room namespace can't be used to reach another's rooms.
    32	    def room_scope
    33	      Current.user.rooms
    34	    end
    35	
    36	    def ensure_can_administer
    37	      head :forbidden unless Current.user.can_administer?(@room)
    38	    end
    39	
    40	    def ensure_permission_to_create_rooms
    41	      if Current.account.settings.restrict_room_creation_to_administrators? && !Current.user.administrator?
    42	        head :forbidden
    43	      end
    44	    end
    45	
    46	    def find_messages
    47	      messages = @room.messages.with_creator.with_attachment_details.with_boosts
    48	
    49	      if show_first_message = messages.find_by(id: params[:message_id])
    50	        @messages = messages.page_around(show_first_message)
    51	      else
    52	        @messages = messages.last_page
    53	      end
    54	    end
    55	
    56	    def room_params
    57	      params.require(:room).permit(:name)
    58	    end
    59	
    60	    def broadcast_remove_room
    61	      broadcast_remove_to :rooms, target: [ @room, :list ]
    62	    end
    63	end
